text:
Michelle (PM): quick sync — we need a concise cutover checklist that covers SLA numbers, docs, support playbooks, monitoring, and pricing verification. who owns each?
Samir (Eng): I can take SLA and perf targets. sketch: p50/p95/p99 latency targets, cold-starts, error budget.
Gonzalo (SRE): monitoring + alerts. also runbooks for service degradation. I'll own runbooks + oncall routing.
Anya (Support): support playbooks and escalation paths from app -> infra -> SRE. need clear customer-facing SLAs for enterprise.
Elena (Docs): I'll own the docs pages: quickstart, troubleshooting, billing examples, and migration notes. need sample curl + SDK snippets. :memo:
Michelle (PM): great. SLA draft: can we put concrete numbers now? want to bake them into the GA contract and the product page.
Samir (Eng): propose: p50 < 60ms (short prompts), p95 < 180ms, p99 < 350ms for 512-token gen on Dedicated baseline. error rate < 0.2%. availability SLA 99.9% monthly.
Anya (Support): 99.9% is fine but we need an incident credit policy + clear refund formula. also support hours: Standard vs Premium (Standard: 9-5, M-F; Premium: 24/7).
Gonzalo (SRE): agree on 99.9% for Dedicated. For Hosted tier, don't promise uptime in free tier. add regional fallback requirements (auto-failover within 60s).
Michelle (PM): acceptance criteria for GA:
- SLA agreed + legal language drafted
- Monitoring dashboards live and smoke tests passing
- Support playbooks published and oncall trained
- Docs complete for self-serve and enterprise sales
- Pricing SKU published and metering validated
Samir (Eng): on monitoring smoke tests: we need end-to-end synthetic tests hitting each model route every 5m and histogram of latencies. alert if p95 > target for 30m.
Gonzalo (SRE): I'll add anomaly detection for token cost spikes + prefix-caching misses. runbook step: if token cost > 2x baseline, rollback to cheaper quantized variant automatically.
Elena (Docs): for docs checklist, I need: quickstart (+SDK), migration guide from v1 endpoints, SLA page, pricing examples, troubleshooting playbook. Can the team drop sample responses?
Samir (Eng): dropping sample payloads now.
Samir (Eng): ```json
{
  "model": "redwood-large-v1",
  "tokens": 512,
  "p50_ms": 58,
  "p95_ms": 165,
  "p99_ms": 340
}
```
Anya (Support): playbook stub:
- customer reports high latency -> run synthetic check -> confirm region -> escalate to SRE if synthetic fails -> open incident and customer comms within 30m.
Michelle (PM): pricing readiness: finance needs final SKU matrix + meter tests. target CP1K (cost per 1k tokens) estimate for public pricing page.
Gonzalo (SRE): metering tests: run a 24h soak generating mixed-length payloads to validate billing signals. I'll schedule a job. deploy-bot: started soak job?
deploy-bot: synthetic-soak-2027 started on infra-ci-3 — logs: https://ci.internal/synthetic-soak-2027 :rocket:
Anya (Support): verification: ensure support tier codes map to correct billing SKUs. we've seen mismatches in staging.
Elena (Docs): also need a short 'what to expect during GA cutover' note for sales and CSMs. bullet list: known limitations, fallback models, degraded features.
Michelle (PM): rollout policy: canary to 5% Hosted + Dedicated for 48h, monitor errors and customer telemetry. if no regression, increase to 25% then full. rollback if error budget > 20% in 24h.
Samir (Eng): canary checklist:
- perf smoke tests green
- end-to-end preds validated on sample corpus (privacy checks)
- billing events accurate
- no new 5xx spikes
Gonzalo (SRE): add ops checklist: runbook link, oncall contact list, escalation matrix.
Anya (Support): I'll run a tabletop for two scenarios: partial region outage + model drift producing hallucinations. need help writing example prompts that trigger known failure modes.
Samir (Eng): will share prompt set.
Elena (Docs): ETA for docs: 5 working days if I get all inputs. can we commit?
Michelle (PM): commit: Samir/Gonzalo/Anya to deliver inputs by EOD Friday. Elena will publish first pass Monday morning.
Gonzalo (SRE): noted. I'll add synthetic dashboards and alert thresholds.
Samir (Eng): I'll iterate SLA wording and draft the legal blurb for refunds.
Anya (Support): I'll validate playbooks with CSMs.
Michelle (PM): next steps: I'll collate into a single cutover playbook and share next week. tagging @here :eyes: — any blockers?
Samir (Eng): none from engineering, except final confirmation on p99 tail for 1k tokens.
Elena (Docs): none.
Anya (Support): none.
Gonzalo (SRE): one note: dependency on CDN config for regional failover — working with infra. might add 24h slip risk.
Michelle (PM): noted — escalate if we see more than 12h delay.
Michelle (PM): thanks all, will post consolidated checklist in #product tomorrow. :tada:
